big_case.notes: A pro se petition from an unpublished Arizona Court of Appeals memorandum decision affirming a divorce decree, raising three fact-bound procedural due process grievances (waiver on a subsection miscitation, a notice defect called harmless, a missing-record presumption). No conflict alleged, no amicus, no response called for, denied on the long-conference order list without a noted dissent. Stakes are confined to the two former spouses.
